review_scope: Read-only factual, metric-boundary and acceptance-language review of draft engineering report and evidence README; no source/raw receipt changes, builds, tests, performance runs or network requests.
verdict: Engineering conclusion supported, with listed documentary scope/inference refinements. No new code/build gate identified. Performance and installer acceptance remain withheld.

accepted_limits: CI normal-thread aggregate rate is not hardware callback stability.
Native test pump is not a DAW event loop.
OFF underproduction and clock rebasing do not prove FFT-only or purely processor-overbudget causation.
Paired update wall and feed-plus-analysis thread CPU have different scopes; old/new narrow FFT timers have different operations.
All wall-inclusive UI spans must not be summed as CPU.
Unassigned Windows process residual is not identified IR/FFT/paint work.
Repeated macOS counterexamples and no physical-host/package sessions block final installer acceptance.
Known pending native-derived links are not new defects; parent is copying completed agent outputs.
